subject: Need of a more flexible annotation

messages.author: a321e6ab7b0cca0d
messages.subject: Need of a more flexible annotation
parts:
Hi,

I would like to add the id-labels at the top of the groups.

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(212)

## Sample data
a1 <- c(3, 9, 4, 5)
df <- data.frame(id=rep(LETTERS[1:length(a1)], a1))
df$co <- paste(df$id, sequence(a1), sep="")
df$value <- runif(nrow(df))

## Plot
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=co, y=value, color=id)) + geom_point()
p1 <- p1 + geom_vline(xintercept = cumsum(a1) + 0.5) + ylim(0, 1)

## I am sure there is a more elegant way to do this....
dat <- data.frame(x = cumsum(a1), lab=unique(df$id))
p1 <- p1 + annotate("text", dat[1, 1], 1, label=dat[1, 2])
p1 <- p1 + annotate("text", dat[2, 1], 1, label=dat[2, 2])
p1 <- p1 + annotate("text", dat[3, 1], 1, label=dat[3, 2])
p1 <- p1 + annotate("text", dat[4, 1], 1, label=dat[4, 2])
p1

Thanks for any help!!
Patrick

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: Need of a more flexible annotation
parts:
Dear Patrick,

Have a look a geom_text(). You can replace all the annotate lines with
the line below.

p1 + geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = x, label = lab), y = max(df$value))

HTH,

Thierry
